What is the difference between an error and an exception?

Supplied answer
A syntax error (or other compile-time error) means the code cannot even be parsed and nothing runs. An
exception is a runtime problem in otherwise valid code - ZeroDivisionError, ValueError, TypeError,
IndexError, KeyError, FileNotFoundError - and it can be caught and handled with try/except.
